verdict.rationale: Quo's AI agent Sona is described as covering all three parts of the story: it answers when the team can't, captures caller details, and hands the conversation to the team. Pricing also lists call transfers, and recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized. The only support is a single homepage marketing line, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on Sona's call-answering and message-taking setup, detail on how handoff or transfer to a human works and what triggers it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, an AI agent can answer the line, take a message, and hand off to a human

citations.quote: Sona answers when your team can't, captures the details you need, and hands the conversation to your team when it matters.
Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
